statement: For every finite ground set E and every pair of normalized nonnegative monotone submodular h,g:2^E -> R_{>=0}, endpoint-oriented one-sided actual-objective greedy returns, deterministically in O(|E|^2) exact value-oracle queries and polynomial arithmetic/comparisons, one permutation pi satisfying 2[h(S_k)+g(E\S_k)] >= max_{|O|=k}[h(O)+g(E\O)] simultaneously for every k=0,...,|E|, with arbitrary unequal totals and zero objectives included. Orient forward when h(E)>=g(E), otherwise swap h/g and reverse the resulting order. Together with the reproduced existing structural lower bound approaching 2, this establishes C_struct=C_poly=2 in the full immutable source.md/problem.md scope; nonnegative unnormalized baselines transfer by subtraction and addition as proved.
contribution: Proposed sharp full-scope deterministic upper bound 2, improving the verified source upper 1+e/(e-1) and matching its existing lower 2. The new proposed mechanism compares actual objective gains in one endpoint-chosen direction, charges the entire union-comparison loss once to the initial endpoint budget, and uses the larger endpoint after gains turn negative. This resolves the entire arbitrary-pair single-permutation gap rather than a restricted case or an intermediate lemma. The lower bound is explicitly prior work. Bounded current primary search found no complete equivalent; fresh review must independently judge correctness, antecedents, substantive innovation and separate STOC significance. No acceptance or readiness is asserted.
